straight.description: The robot will move straight forward along the +x direction for 0.45 m and stop. Its final orientation will remain facing +x at 0 radians.

turn_then_drive.description: The robot will rotate 90° left in place, then drive straight 0.30 m in the +y direction. It will finish facing +y at π/2 radians.

arc.description: The robot will move forward while turning left, creating a curved arc. It will travel about 0.60 m along the arc and change its heading by 1.6 radians, or about 91.7° to the left.
